summary.text: Devin Lander is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Senate District 43 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Jacob Ashby.
His campaign website describes him as a lifelong public servant, educator and advocate who was born and raised in a working-class family in Upstate New York.

paragraphs.text: Lander's campaign website says the 43rd Senate District covers parts of Albany, Rensselaer and Washington counties.

According to Ballotpedia, the Democratic and Working Families Party primaries scheduled for June 23, 2026, were canceled and he advanced to the general election without appearing on the primary ballot.
His campaign website lists utility and household costs, health care costs, environmental cleanup along the Hudson River, school funding and infrastructure upgrades among his priorities.
